name: @crfrsr/monorepo
description: crfrsr Design System - Shared components for React and React Native

scripts.publish:all: npm run build && npm publish --workspace=@crfrsr/core && npm publish --workspace=@crfrsr/ui && npm publish --workspace=@crfrsr/ui-native
scripts.yalc:publish: npm run build && yalc publish --push packages/core && yalc publish --push packages/react && yalc publish --push packages/react-native
scripts.yalc:push: npm run build && yalc push packages/core && yalc push packages/react && yalc push packages/react-native
scripts.yalc:watch: npm run yalc:publish && (npm run build --workspaces --if-present -- --watch & nodemon --watch packages --ext js,d.ts --ignore 'packages/**/node_modules/**' --exec 'npm run yalc:push')
scripts.pack:all: npm run build && mkdir -p .pack && npm pack --workspace=@crfrsr/core --pack-destination=.pack && npm pack --workspace=@crfrsr/ui --pack-destination=.pack && npm pack --workspace=@crfrsr/ui-native --pack-destination=.pack
